searchText: Hey guys! i participated in KZG ceremony, it says that my address has already contributed but i can't see it in contributions list. Has anyone faced such a problem? The search box in ethereum.org does not find anything for "kzg" and not a single relevant link for "ceremony" <nicoserranop> > <nicoserranop> It might be caused by the blacklist. If the sequencer gave you a spot to contribute and you took more time than expected (3 min) then it would include your address in the blacklist to prevent spam attacks.
